body:
Approved spec: .adlc/specs/SC-025-agent-offer-tool-guardrail-callbacks.md (v2.3, builds on SC-023). Built before gating on 18 Oct 2026, then reviewed; three reproduced defects in check_card_offer fixed. Do not call Gemini in tests. tests/test_v2_page.py is updated only where SC-025 supersedes it (re-plans keep the shopper's quantities and trip cost). Cut-off 17:00 Colombo (E4).

Acceptance criteria:
1. Agent tool prices a described offer; unstated terms left out; invalid day refused. Verify: python -m pytest tests/test_offer_check.py -q
2. Unstated terms never ground a number; callbacks run in the real ADK loop. Verify: python -m pytest tests/test_guardrails.py -q
3. Whole-pack quantities. Verify: python -m pytest tests/test_v22_page.py -q
4. Every test passes. Verify: python -m pytest -q
5. README checker passes. Verify: python scripts/check_judge_readme.py
title: v2.3 build: check_card_offer agent tool, guardrails as ADK callbacks, whole-pack quantities
